'''February 2001 Los Gatos tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Los Gatos, California on 24 February 2001. [[John Monroe]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1783">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-los-gatos-ca-2-24-01d1783/ los-gatos-ca-2-24-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 25 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-los-gatos-ca-2-24-01d1783/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Los Gatos, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[John Monroe]]
